Tesla Renames 'Full Self-Driving' to 'Assisted Driving' in Europe

Tesla has renamed its 'Full Self-Driving' software to 'Assisted Driving' in Europe as the company seeks regulatory clearance for the technology. The change in branding aims to comply with European regulations and facilitate the software's approval.
